title: Line Item Complete Request
description: Line item object. Expected to use the currency of the parent object.

quantity.description: Always an integer step count. On Platform requests, steps use the item's Business-authoritative sale basis; omitting `item.quantity_unit` makes no assertion and does not imply `each`. On Business responses, `item.quantity_unit` describes the basis; if absent, it encodes the `each` machine identity (`C62`, 0) and `quantity` counts whole items.

parent_id.description: Parent line item identifier for any nested structures.
